WHY: The table names the shell extensions (.sh, .bash) and CMake extension (.cmake), with CMakeLists.txt listed by file name separately from the extension. The answer also says `_ts_language_for` routes ".sh and CMakeLists.txt" to nothing when the grammar is absent.
